basisCustom: Shared cost uses the saved split.
basisDirect: Shared cost is split by each work order's share of direct cost.
basisNone: Shared cost remains unassigned until a custom split is saved.
empty: No work orders on this project yet.
pageEmpty: No plan or actuals for this work order yet.
pendingCrewHours: {{hours}} h on timesheets not yet approved are not counted.

plan.format: Enter a number of zero or more, with up to 2 decimals.
plan.title: Plan for {{number}}

profit.title: Profit per discipline
profit.incomplete: Incomplete: validated work without a rate
profit.empty: No validated revenue or cost per discipline yet.
profit.revenueNote: Revenue is validated progress at the contract rate.

setting.title: Profit per discipline
setting.label: Show revenue next to cost per discipline
setting.helper: Adds a table to the project's plan-vs-actual section and a discipline field on contract lines. Off by default.
setting.adminOnly: Only an Admin can change this.

reason.commitment: Commitment, not summed (its bill carries the cost)
reason.unassigned: Not assigned to a work order
reason.splitWhenCustom: Split only when a custom split is set
reason.stocked: Bought into stock, counted when issued
reason.transfer: Moved to site, still on hand

restrictedNote: Work-order cost and margin are restricted for your role.

split.sumUnreadable: Each percentage is 0 to 100, with up to 4 decimals.
split.title: Shared-cost split

splitMixed: Work orders use more than one currency, so shared cost is split within each currency.
splitStale: The saved split is stale: a work order was added or cancelled since. The default is used until someone saves it again.
title: Plan vs actual
uncosted: {{hours}} h carry no rate and are not in the cost.

labour.title: Labour cost by class
labour.note: Part of the direct cost above, from approved hours at each person's cost rate.

performance.title: Cost and schedule performance
performance.basis: Earned value is validated daily-report progress at contract rate. Planned value runs in a straight line between the work order's start and end dates. Actual cost is the direct cost recorded to the work order.
performance.projectBasis: Work orders issued or closed, summed together. Earned value is validated progress at contract rate; the plan is calendar-linear.

costVariance.positive: Earned value exceeds actual cost by {{amount}}
costVariance.negative: Actual cost exceeds earned value by {{amount}}

hidden.noDates: Add a start and end date to see the schedule index
hidden.noPlanYet: Planned work has not started yet
hidden.unrated_one: 1 validated progress line has no rate, so no index is shown
hidden.unrated_other: {{count}} validated progress lines have no rate, so no index is shown
hidden.acIncomplete: Cost cannot be totalled yet: a cost line has no date or no amount
hidden.acIncompleteUndated_one: Cost cannot be totalled yet: 1 cost line has no date
hidden.acIncompleteUndated_other: Cost cannot be totalled yet: {{count}} cost lines have no date
hidden.notComparable: Not comparable: some cost is in another currency
hidden.excluded: No figures for a draft or cancelled work order

performance.counted: {{included}} work orders counted, {{excluded}} left out because their figures are incomplete or they are not issued or closed
performance.truncated: The first 500 work orders are shown; {{count}} more are left out.
performance.nothing: Nothing is recorded yet for this work order.
performance.loadError: Couldn't load cost and schedule performance

earnedBilled.title: Earned and billed revenue
earnedBilled.packTitle: Earned and billed revenue by project
earnedBilled.note: Earned is validated daily progress at the contract rate. Billed is claims and invoices, excluding tax.
earnedBilled.packNote: Earned is validated daily progress to date; cost and billed are the project tab's figures, so they agree.
earnedBilled.incompleteWorkOrders: Incomplete: some work orders have no validated progress or a missing rate
earnedBilled.withoutProgress: {{count}} of {{total}} work orders have no validated progress yet.
earnedBilled.empty: No Issued or Closed work orders yet.
earnedBilled.loadError: Couldn't load earned and billed revenue

idle.title: Idle time cost by reason
idle.note: Shown apart: this time was already paid, so it is part of the direct cost above and is not added again. Cost at the work order's average hourly cost.
idle.noteFull: Shown apart: the people hours are already in labour cost and the standby money is already in equipment cost, so they are not added again. People are the crew present each day at the work order's average hourly cost.
